description: This Java class 'NameTemplate' extends 'LayoutTemplate' and provides functionality for formatting person names based on a customizable layout template within the OpenMRS platform. It includes methods to generate a formatted name string from a PersonName object, utilizing layout configuration and tokens.

classes.name: NameTemplate
classes.description: A class responsible for generating formatted person names based on layout templates, extending the 'LayoutTemplate' class to customize name rendering.

methods.name: getLayoutToken
methods.description: Returns the layout token identifier for name tokens, used within templates.

methods.name: getNonLayoutToken
methods.description: Returns the token used to denote non-layout or static parts in the template.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats a given PersonName object into a string based on the configured layout and tokens. It processes template lines, resolves tokens to actual name parts, and joins them into a single string.

methods.name: getLayoutSupportInstance
methods.description: Provides an instance of layout support specific to Name templates, returning NameSupport.
